collectionMethod: Manual capture of the official Command Code pages (English) around 10:35 Beijing time on 2026-10-27: the GOAT plan page, the pricing-limits resource page and the public pricing page, read as published, and compared against the 2026-10-26 capture of the same pages. Plan-page FAQ wording, the GOAT usage-limit block, the pricing-limits plan table, the public pricing page credits table and the embedded RSC payload (budgetUsd per model) were checked. Research-only — no adopted row generated, no adopted value changed, no script changed.
scope: Command Code GOAT official pages only. One topic changed on 2026-10-27: the plan-level shared-credit wording moved from a flat $70 to an 'up to $100' phrasing, with the 5-hour and weekly limits moving to 'up to $20' / 'up to $50'. No per-model allowance changed (all 59 GOAT models keep the same budgetUsd in the embedded RSC payload), no model was added to or removed from the GOAT plan, no price changed, no leaderboard/score data touched, no OpenCode Go rows touched, no adopted.csv row.

interpretation.summary: The plan-level shared monthly pool wording moved from a flat $70 to 'up to $100' (with the 5-hour and weekly limits moving to 'up to $20' and 'up to $50'), while every per-model allowance in the RSC payload stayed exactly where it was.

ambiguity.statement: The 'up to' phrasing is ambiguous. It may only describe the maximum per-model allowance reachable under the plan (i.e. the pool is still $70 and a model may use up to its own allowance within it), or it may mean the shared pool cap itself is now $100.
supportingFacts: The FAQ sentence still says 'up to $70 on models like GLM-5.2', so $70 is still named as a model-level amount on the same page.
All 59 GOAT models keep their previous budgetUsd, and the highest is still Ling 3.1 Flash at $100, so no per-model allowance was raised to match a new $100 pool.
https://commandcode.ai/pricing still advertises the GOAT plan at $70 monthly credits, i.e. the marketing page was not updated.
The same 'up to' rewrite was applied to the Pro plan ($80 -> 'Up to $110'), which suggests a marketing-wide wording change rather than a GOAT-specific pool change.

repoPipeline.commentOnFile: Command Code GOAT: shared monthly pool $70 + per-model monthly allowance; effective=min(70, allowance).
repoPipeline.note: The pipeline still reads a flat $70 shared pool. Under the unchanged per-model allowances, raising the pool to $100 would only affect models whose allowance currently exceeds $70 (Ling 3.1 Flash at $100, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (latest) at $80, GLM-5.3 Flash at $80); models at or below $70 would be unaffected. No such change is made here.
